title: Ruby Totem Of Undying
description: This resource pack turns your totem of undying ruby!
body:
# Ruby Totem of Undying

**Upgrade your survival game with expensive style!** This resource pack transforms the classic Totem of Undying into a shiny Ruby Totem of Undying, giving it a rare, and expensive endgame look that matches your riches.

## Why download it?
- Shiny Design: A bright, premium aesthetic that feels worthy of the most rare, and expensive looking material in Minecraft.
- Perfect for Hardcore Players: Adds a sense of value to your life-saving item.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works flawlessly with other resource packs and shaders. Survive in style, because even immortality deserves an upgrade!
# Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
